units: Lexical source tokens of the proof body, including by; not LLM/BPE tokens

interpretation.floor: Conditional on successful ordinary tactic proofs accepted by the current local by-only gate: the by keyword and at least one tactic token require at least two tokens.
interpretation.not_attainability: A floor of two does not show that any of the 60 problems has a two-token proof.
interpretation.not_exact: Existence of a shortest proof does not supply an algorithm or a certificate of its length. No problem-specific optimality is established here.
interpretation.library: Fixed source/version contexts are assumed. New free helper declarations and changes to imported libraries are not included.
interpretation.lemma_calls: by exact helper has three tokens only when helper elaborates without explicit arguments. This is the length of a proposed construction, not a universal lower bound. No such helper is assumed to exist.
interpretation.official_scope: The by-only floor is a local candidate-language restriction, not a verified competition-wide restriction. Allowing term proofs can admit one-token bodies.
interpretation.reference: Reference lengths are measurements of supplied proofs, not proven minima. Text-gate and token-metric differences are retained explicitly; no official-valid upper bounds are certified by this static analysis.
